title: Verify staging acceptance guards and keep production execution blocked
summary: 227 distinct local tests, both TypeScript checks, focused lint and isolated build passed. Hosted staging remains blocked on connected access and reviewed configuration; production remains NO-GO.

changes.detail: Require independent production/staging identities and verify immutable Vercel deployment metadata before transmitting staging sessions; reject incomplete hosting inventories and block legacy production execution.
Synthetic regressions, offline evidence template and owner dashboard/handoff instructions; retain historical discovery and all previous reports.
Explicitly distinguish live deployment metadata from operator-attested database/environment evidence and unverified database read-only transaction mode.

validation.name: Application and worker regression
validation.detail: 154 application/SEO/security/owner/client/history tests and 71 worker tests. Final 16-tooling-test run includes two additional CLI tests, giving 227 distinct passing tests; zero failed/skipped in final runs.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused ESLint
validation.detail: Root and learning app type checks with incremental disabled; final six tooling/test files lint clean.

validation.name: Isolated production build
validation.detail: Node24 build completed 2026-10-20T12:16:38.399Z; BUILD_ID exists; synthetic credentials and blocked runtime fetches; no deployment. Initial font-fetch failure retained; approved retry permitted public font downloads. Shared tracing-root warning limits packaging claims.

validation.name: Source and migration integrity
validation.detail: All six pinned migration hashes and all 51 prior runtime inventory hashes match. No runtime application or migration changes.

validation.name: Hosted staging, production, browser/native and preview
validation.detail: Fresh discovery reports Vercel and Supabase unconnected. Historical database findings not reverified. No hosted app/database request, settings change, paid request, deployment or activation. Native/browser source unchanged; historical checks not rerun. No preview verified.

validation.name: Retained failed checks
validation.detail: Two test-harness issues corrected and rerun: private variable-name false positive and imported CLI bypassing main entrypoint. Initial failed logs preserved.
